build_standard_geometry: build a standard geometry from StandardGeometryIntermediates for use in JAX-jitted functions
test_stack_geometries: test stacking multiple standard geometries into a single stacked geometry with combined mesh data
test_post_init_flips_psi: test that post_init flips decreasing psi arrays to increasing order
test_post_init_enforces_positive: test that post_init enforces positive definite values for Phi, F, vpr, and flux surface averages
test_g0_g1_cauchy_schwarz: test that g0^2 / g1 ratio satisfies Cauchy-Schwarz inequality for circular, chease, eqdsk, and imas geometries
